'''Caffi Shish''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caffi Shish appears as a scavenging crew skill trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
